title: GOD OF SARAH, DO FOR ME WHAT MEN SAY IS IMPOSSIBLE
text: I welcome you in the name of Jesus. Tonight, the spirit of God is about to do something remarkable in your life. The same God who appeared to Abraham and Sarah when the world had already written them off is the God we are calling upon tonight. He is the God who makes impossibilities bow. He is the God who defies time, natural laws, and human verdicts. Genesis 18:14 asks a timeless question. Is anything too hard for the Lord? At the appointed time, I will return unto thee according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son. I came to announce to you prophetically, tonight is your appointed time. Every impossibility in your life is about to become a testimony. The Lord sent me to tell someone that though men have written you off, though experts have said it is finished, though circumstances mock you, the God of Sarah will do for you what men say is impossible. Your womb that has been called buried will carry children. Your life that has been mocked will be celebrated. Your finances that have been dry will overflow. Your destiny that has been locked will be opened by fire. I decree and declare by the power that raised Jesus from the dead, let every impossibility in your life bow to the name of Jesus. Romans 8:11 says, "But if the spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies." The same spirit that quickened Sarah's womb is here tonight to quicken your life. Hear me. Every satanic verdict over your life is reversed now in the name of Jesus. Every handwriting of ordinances against you is blotted out. Colossians 2:14-15 says, "Blottting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross, and having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it. Tonight by the blood of Jesus, every evil record against you is cancelled. Lift your hand where you are and make this decree. I decree. Thus sayeth the spirit of God. Someone under the sound of my voice has been told by doctors that it is impossible that your case is closed. But tonight, the God who made Sarah laugh will make you laugh. Men will see your testimony and be forced to say, "This is the Lord's doing, and it is marvelous in our eyes. I prophesy into your family. Where there has been dryness, let water spring forth." Isaiah 43:19 says, "Behold, I will do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert. I decree that impossibilities in your family line are overturned. What no one in your bloodline has achieved, you will achieve by the mercies of God. I speak over your finances. Every impossibility around your resources is shattered. 2 Corinthians 9:8 declares, "And God is able to make all grace abound toward you, that ye always having all sufficiency in all things may abound to every good work. By this scripture I declare over your hands, let the power to prosper rest upon you. No more empty pockets, no more begging, no more struggling. I decree healing over your health. Every diagnosis that men have said is final, I reverse it by the power of the blood of Jesus. Jeremiah 3:17 says, "For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, sayeth the Lord. I command every cancer, every diabetes, every heart condition, every strange affliction, every demonic oppression be destroyed now in the name of Jesus. I release militant warfare over your destiny. Every evil altar speaking impossibility over your life, I command it to catch fire. Every satanic covenant tying you to delay, break now. Every witchcraft attack sent against your progress, return to sender. Psalm 7:15-16 says, "He made a pit and did it, and is falling into the ditch which he made. His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pit. Let the arrows of the enemy go back to the senders in the mighty name of Jesus. Tonight, angels of breakthrough are released. Angels of war are fighting for you. Angels of favor are surrounding you. Angels of healing are ministering to you. Psalm 34:7 says, "The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him and deliverth them." Your deliverance has come. Your testimony has come. Your season has come. Father, we exalt you. You are the God of all flesh. And there is nothing too hard for you. Thank you because impossibilities are bowing. Mountains are moving, chains are breaking, and doors are opening. We seal these prayers with thanksgiving. And we declare that no force of hell will reverse this miracle. Now beloved, lift your hands and shout it three times. My God of Sarah has remembered me. Beloved, hear me by the spirit of God. When the God of Sarah steps into a man's story, impossibility must bow. Men may laugh at you now, but when God is done, they will laugh with you. Genesis 21:6 says, "And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh so that all that hear will laugh with me. I prophesy over you before this season is over. God will give you a testimony that will make your mockers gather to celebrate with you. I decree and declare everything that has mocked your faith is turning into a testimony. Every delay is broken. Every stagnation is scattered. Every siege is lifted. Whatever men said is impossible. By the God of Sarah, it is possible. I stand as a prophet of the most high and I declare over your family no more impossibility. Where baroness has lingered, fruitfulness now appears. Where poverty has reigned, abundance now takes over. Where sickness has prevailed, healing now manifest. Where shame has covered you, honor now clothe you. Isaiah 61:7 declares, "For your shame ye shall have double, and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion. Therefore, in their land they shall possess the double. Everlasting joy shall be unto them. Receive double for your shame in the mighty name of Jesus. I command every pharaoh holding your every evil covenant tying you to impossibility. I break it now in the name of Jesus. Every cause of limitation be broken. Every altar of stagnation scatter by fire every witchcraft projection against your destiny but fire now in the name of Jesus. Psalm 68:1 declares, "Let God arise. Let his enemies be scattered. Let them also that hate him flee before him. Let God arise in your life and let every enemy scatter. I prophesy into your finances. No more empty hands." The Bible says in Deuteronomy 28:12, "The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand, and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow. From today you will not beg to eat. You will not struggle to pay bills. You will not be stranded. The Lord himself will make you a lender to nations. I speak into your health. That long-standing affliction dies now. That strange sickness disappears now. That satanic arrow fired into your body, goes back to sender now. Exodus 23:25-26 says, "And ye shall serve the Lord your God, and he shall bless thy bread and thy water, and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee. There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren in thy land. The number of thy days I will fulfill. Therefore, I decree and declare your health is restored, your strength is renewed, your years are preserved. Beloved, hear this. The same way Sarah's womb was visited by the spirit of God, your destiny is being visited now, your womb is being visited, your marriage is being visited, your career is being visited, your ministry is being visited. Ezekiel 37:14 says, "And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land. Then shall ye know that I, the Lord, have spoken it, and performed it, saith the Lord." Life is entering your dry bones now in the name of Jesus. I decree and declare any man or woman, every evil covenant tying you to impossibility, I break it now in the name of Jesus. Life is entering your dry bones now in the name of Jesus. I decree and declare any man or woman. Now I turn to your finances. Hear me beloved. Poverty is not just a condition. It is a spirit. Deuteronomy 8:18 says, "But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God. For it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant, which he swear unto thy fathers, as it is this day. I release upon you the power to get wealth. Every financial curse upon your lineage is broken. Every altar of hardship fighting your prosperity, I command it to scatter. Every satanic manipulation against your business, your job, your contracts, your career be destroyed now in the name of Jesus. Lift your hands and shout. By the blood of Jesus, I break free from financial captivity. I command open doors. I command divine connections. I command supernatural supplies. Let rivers flow in my desert. Let treasures of darkness be released. Let men give unto my bosom, pressed down, shaken together, running over. I speak to families right now. Any household that has been under witchcraft attack today your deliverance has come. Any home where there has been baroness receive fruitfulness. Any home under the yoke of marital delay, the God who remembered Sarah will remember you. Genesis 21:2 says, "For Sarah conceived and bear Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him. I decree this is your set time. Delay is broken. Every arrow of division in your marriage, return to sender. Every power that vowed you will not experience peace in your home. May the fire of God consume them. Thus sayeth the spirit of God, someone under the sound of my voice, you have been mocked for years over the issue of childbirth. They said it is impossible. They said your womb is closed. But the God of Sarah who caused laughter is opening your womb. You shall carry your miracle child and not only one. God is going to surprise you with multiple testimonies in the name of Jesus. Now I confront witchcraft projections against destinies. Psalm 7:15-16 says, "He made a pit and did it and is falling into the ditch which finally I release angelic intervention over your life." Psalm 34:7 says, "The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him and deliverth them." Let angels surround your home. Let angels guide your children. Let angels fight your battles. Let angels open prison doors. Let angels bring your answers swiftly. Father, we thank you. We exalt you because what men said was impossible, you have made possible. What men said would not happen, you have brought to pass, for with you nothing shall be impossible. Blessed be your name forever. Therefore, I prophesy as you step into this new day, carry laughter, carry testimony, carry results, carry favor, carry breakthrough, carry lifting, carry the evidence of God's faithfulness in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Amen and amen. Listen carefully. There are moments in a man's life where God himself decides to turn sorrow into laughter, shame into glory, and impossibility into testimony. Genesis 21:6 records Sarah's own confession. And Sarah said, God had made me to laugh so that all that hear will laugh with me. That is not just the laughter of comedy. It is the laughter of prophecy fulfilled. The laughter of mockery silenced. The laughter of destiny restored. Tonight, as surely as the Lord leaves, may your life produce that kind of laughter. In the name of Jesus, I prophesy over you. The days of sorrow are over. The days of unanswered prayers are terminated. Every night of weeping is giving way to a morning of joy. Psalm 30:5 declares, "Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning. Your morning season has come in the name of Jesus. You shall laugh with joy at your testimony." For years Sarah carried shame, ridicule, baroness. She endured the whispers of her neighbors, the mocking glances, the silent reproaches. But when the set time came, God himself visited her. Genesis 18:14 is the question God asks. Is anything too hard for the Lord? By the authority of scripture, I declare over your life, no matter how long it has lingered, I decree over your finances, no more empty hands, no more dry seasons. Deuteronomy 28:12 says, "The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand, and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow. Receive open heavens now. Receive divine ideas, divine helpers, divine opportunities. Let contracts locate you. Let businesses open to you. Let doors of favor swing wide for you. Every power that vowed you will not prosper. Let the fire of God consume them. I speak to marriages. The Lord who restored Sarah's joy will restore peace in your home. Every strange hand fighting your union, I cut it off in the name of Jesus. Every arrow of division, every satanic projection of divorce be broken now. May your family become a testimony. May your children become signs and wonders. Isaiah 8:18 says, "Behold, I and the children whom the Lord had given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the Lord of hosts which dwelleth in Mount Zion. Now I speak to health. Every sickness, every affliction, every disease mocking your prayer life, mocking your faith, mocking your confession, hear the word of the Lord." But he was wounded for our transgressions. He was bruised for our iniquities. The chastisement of our peace was upon him and with his stripes we are healed. Isaiah 53:5 I decree healing over your body. I decree restoration over your health. I command cancer to die. I command high blood pressure to normalize. I command kidney problems, heart problems, blood diseases be healed now in Jesus name. Thus sayeth the spirit of God, someone under the sound of my voice, they told you you will die before the end of the year, but I stand as a prophet of God, and I overturn that verdict. You shall not die, but leave to declare the works of the Lord. Psalm 118:17. Instead of tears, you will laugh. Instead of mourning, you will celebrate. Instead of shame, you will wear the garment of honor. Lift your hands and decree. Every evil plan against my life, scatter by fire. Every altar of witchcraft raised against my father tonight, we exalt you. We acknowledge that you are the same yesterday, today, and forever. You who turn baroness into fruitfulness. You who rolled away reproach. You who turn ridicule into laughter, visit your people tonight, scatter every evil altar, destroy every satanic yoke, reverse every evil decree. Let the testimonies of your people bring glory to your name. Beloved, rejoice. The God of Sarah is alive. He has spoken and he will not lie. He has promised and he will not fail. Your season of laughter has come in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Amen and amen. Beloved, hear me well. There are battles in life that only the God of Sarah can win. Sarah's womb was not just closed by biology. It was a spiritual contention. But the God who sits in the heavens broke every protocol. Psalm 2:4 says, "He that siteth in the heavens shall laugh. The Lord shall have them in derision. I decree over your life. Every enemy mocking your destiny, the Lord will laugh at them. Every altar of delay be consumed. Every voice of impossibility be silenced by fire. I stand tonight in the authority of Jesus Christ and command every evil plan against your life to scatter. Job 5:12 says, "He disappointed the devices of the crafty so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise." I prophesy every evil enterprise against your health, it is frustrated. Every evil enterprise against your finances, it is frustrated. Every evil enterprise against your children, it is frustrated. By the blood of Jesus, your enemies will not prevail. Lift your right hand and say, "By the power of the blood of Jesus, I cancel every evil plan. I decree and declare, no weapon formed against me shall prosper. Every arrow of death go back to sender. Every incantation, every divination, every manipulation of sorcery scatter by fire in the name of Jesus. Beloved, the God of Sarah is also the God of divine remembrance. Genesis 8:1 says, "And God remember." Now I direct prayers to your finances. Lay your hand upon your head and decree, I am not poor. I am not barren. I am not empty. I receive abundance. I receive increase. I receive overflow. I decree open doors in business. I decree supernatural favor in contracts. I decree jobs for the jobless. I decree promotions for those stagnated. The power of God is lifting you from scarcity to plenty. The Bible says in Malachi 3:10, "Prove me now herewith, sayeth the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it. I decree the windows of heaven open over you. Every devourer is rebuked. Every cankerworm, every palmer, every waster assigned to eat your harvest be destroyed. From today your storehouses will not be empty, your hands will not be dry. Thus sayeth the spirit of God, someone under the sound of my voice, they plotted to make you redundant at your workplace, but the Lord says he is turning it into your promotion. Another person, you have been denied your entitlement for years. Tonight, angels of God are released to enforce your release. every hanging financial blessing be released in Jesus' name. I turn now to family altars. Joshua 24:15 says, "But as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. Every altar of idolatry speaking against your family, break now. Every covenant of blood sacrifices speaking against your children, break now. Every demonic voice of premature death in your lineage, I silence you by the blood of Jesus. Every altar that swallows blessings, catch fire. Lift your voice and shout. I decree and declare, "My family is free. My marriage is free. My children are free. We shall serve the Lord. We shall be for signs and wonders. Our destiny is preserved. Our testimony is unstoppable. Hear me beloved. Laughter is not only an emotion, it is a weapon. Psalm 126:1-2 says, "When the Lord tonged again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream. Then was our mouth sealed with laughter and our tongue." Beloved, the power of God is moving right now. Some of you will sleep tonight and wake up with phone calls of answered prayers. Some of you will see the hand of God break barriers that stood for years. The God of Sarah is at work. He has remembered you. He has lifted you. He has honored you. You will laugh with joy at your testimony in Jesus mighty
